verdict.rationale: The SOS publishes business-entity, DBA and UCC data through the state open-data portal, and a probe got keyless JSON back from the business-entities dataset endpoint. Its own Intelligence Center also offers business data and data requests, so a user's entity records can be pulled in an open, machine-readable format. This covers public registry records, not a documented self-service export of everything tied to a user's account (filings, documents, prepaid account, notifications), and the API sits on the Socrata platform rather than the registry itself. Missing for 10: a documented per-account full data export, export of filed documents and filing history in open formats, and independent or hands-on confirmation beyond a single one-record GET.
